verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an official Python package for writing scripts that control and extend the terminal (docs-13). The GitHub README describes it as full automation, covering custom status bar components, triggers, menu items and new features. A community user confirms it lets you 'touch pretty much everything', and official AppleScript support adds a second scripting path. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond Python, evidence of API reference depth or versioning, and machine-readable or AI-oriented docs (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404).
